speaker: charlie
text: That's your ParkSyde Bright Side for Friday the second of October. Whales waving goodbye, coral about to put on a light show, and footy finals keeping the whole state entertained.

speaker: alice
text: It really has been a ripper of a week for good news around here. Makes you proud to call South East Queensland home, honestly.

speaker: charlie
text: Couldn't agree more. Big thanks to Sam for keeping us dry and informed on the weather front today.

speaker: alice
text: And thank you all for tuning in, we love having you with us. Get outside this weekend and soak some of this spring sunshine up while it lasts.

speaker: charlie
text: Too right. I'm Alex Mercer, that's Jamie, we'll catch you next time on ParkSyde Bright Side, stay bright and we'll see you then.
